  "text": "3 Locate the Geometric Entity Selection section. From the Selection list, choose
  All (Tapered Waveguide).




4 Locate the Variables section. In the table, enter the following settings:

Name        Expression                                      Unit          Description
kx          ewbe.beta_1+(ewbe.beta_2-                       rad/m
            ewbe.beta_1)*x/d_taper
phi         (kx+ewbe.beta_1)*x/2                            rad

  The wave vector component kx changes value linearly from the propagation constant
  for the input port to that for the output port. Thereby, the phase phi will depend
  quadratically on the propagation coordinate, x.

Output Waveguide
1 Right-click Tapered Waveguide and choose Duplicate.
2 In the Settings window for Variables, type Output Waveguide in the Label text field.




                                                              25 |   TAPERED WAVEGUIDE
"
